en.title: Nabla Lab
intro: Nabla Lab began in 2025 with students from the joint undergraduate programme between Harbin Institute of Technology, Weihai and the University of Strathclyde. We now study and work at different universities, and continue to collaborate on research.
Our interests include fluid mechanics, wave–structure interaction, computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamics and noise. We also share methods and experience from our research.

topics.title: Waves and structures
topics.text: Wave loading, gap resonance, fluid–structure interaction and offshore renewable energy.

topics.title: Computation and theory
topics.text: Computational fluid dynamics, theoretical analysis and physics-informed neural networks.

topics.title: Aerodynamics and noise
topics.text: UAV aerodynamics and noise reduction, including problems related to low-altitude flight.

en.peopleIntro: Five members with a shared undergraduate background, now continuing research at different institutions.
en.editorialIntro: Signed articles by our members on research, technology and everyday life.

zh.title: Nabla Lab
intro: Nabla Lab 成立于 2025 年。我们相识于哈工大（威海）—思克莱德大学联合培养项目，目前在不同院校继续学习和研究，并保持科研合作。
我们的研究兴趣包括流体力学、波浪–结构物作用、计算流体力学、空气动力学与噪声，也交流研究方法和科研经验。

topics.title: 波浪与结构物
topics.text: 波浪荷载、间隙共振、流固耦合，以及海上可再生能源。

topics.title: 计算与理论方法
topics.text: 计算流体力学、理论分析与物理信息神经网络。

topics.title: 空气动力学与噪声
topics.text: 无人机空气动力学、降噪，以及低空飞行中的相关工程问题。

zh.peopleIntro: 五位成员有着共同的本科教育背景，目前在不同院校继续学习、研究与合作。
zh.editorialIntro: 成员署名文章，记录关于科研、技术和日常生活的思考。
